sources.title: Knowledge Compilation, Width and Quantification
sources.role: Structured deterministic DNNF width and the cost of projection/quantification; comparison target for certified residual messages.

sources.title: On the relation between structured d-DNNFs and SDDs
sources.role: Structured canonical knowledge-compilation context and the importance of representation language and fixed decomposition structure.

sources.title: A Strongly Exponential Separation of DNNFs from CNF Formulas
sources.role: Representation-specific exponential lower bounds on expander CNFs; explicit warning that failure of one compilation language is not a lower bound against all algorithms.

sources.title: Parameterized Compilation Lower Bounds for Restricted CNF-formulas
sources.role: Parameterized lower bounds for DNNF compilation and additional pressure against treating one message language as universally succinct.

claim_boundary: These sources motivate representation and width comparisons only. C035's merge theorem and executable controls are internal results, and no cited source resolves P versus NP.
